specs.Camera Lens: 10X optical zoom telephoto lens for capturing distant subjects with enhanced detail.

features: Stunning Video and Photo Quality: Capture life's precious moments with stunning clarity using the LEQTRONIQ 10X Option Zoom Camera's 4K/2.7K/1080P/720P UHD video recording capabilities and take high-resolution 75MP-3MP photos.
Advanced Creative Features: Enjoy 10+ kinds of filters, beauty function, and 9 multi-function camera modes, including auto, continuous shooting, and slow-motion video, to unleash your creativity.
Seamless Connectivity and Sharing: Built-in Wi-Fi enables quick uploading and sharing of your content, while the webcam function allows for live streaming and video calling.

Professional-Grade Optics and Features: Take advantage of the upgraded optical zoom system, autofocus features, and 3 framing grids (Golden Ratio, Crosshatch, Rule of Thirds) to ensure high-quality captures.

Convenient and Practical Design: Record while charging via USB cable, and expand your creativity with the tripod, hot shoe, and USB port, making this camera the perfect companion for any photography or videography enthusiast.
